58  ;  Frederic  Hahnemann,  13  ;  Baehr,  11 ;  Meyer,  6 ;  the  rest  are  quotations
from  the  old  school ;  total,  947.

proved edition,  although  containing  some  symptoms  from  Fowler's  solu-

ous collections  of  poisonings,  and  the  lack  of  symptoms  produced  by  higher
potencies.  This  view  is  corroborated  by  the  collection  of  the  Sulphur
